faqList.title: Can I get an Odinfortune Casino no deposit bonus?
faqList.text: No deposit bonuses are not part of our standard standing promotions \- our welcome package is triggered by your first deposit rather than registration alone. Our promotional schedule is updated regularly, so we recommend checking the bonuses section of your account after signing up for any limited-period no deposit offers that may be running at the time.

faqList.title: How do wagering requirements work?
faqList.text: Wagering requirements determine how many times you must play through bonus funds before they become withdrawable cash. Our welcome bonuses carry a x40 requirement with a 7-day completion window, while weekly reload bonuses operate at x35 or x40 depending on the specific promotion. The maximum stake allowed during any active bonus period is £5 per round, regardless of which promotion is in play.

faqList.title: Do I need an Odinfortune Casino promo code to Claim Bonuses?
faqList.text: No \- all standard welcome and reload bonuses are available without a promo code. That said, a dedicated code field appears during registration should you have one, and we occasionally send exclusive codes to players via email promotions. If you have a code, enter it at sign-up before completing your registration to ensure it is applied correctly.
